page.layout: One column of running text, roman and italic, with a centred section number "LXXIX." between the paragraphs. No marginal notes. At the foot, the gathering signature "Ii 2". Page number 499 and running head at the top.

l.i: [?]ata hac de regina fama, suos habebunt
despectui maritos, cum diceretur reginam
Vastim ab Assuero rege accersitam, non
venisse: atque hoc regina factum obiicient
aliquando primariae Persidis et Mediae mu-
lieres, quae id audiverint, omnibus regiis
proceribus, quae res magnum contemptum
pariet, & indignitatem. Quamobrem si
tibi Rex ita placet, promulgetur regium
à te decretum, idq; irrevocabili Persica
& Medica lege scriptum, ne regina Vastis
in conspectu regis Assueri veniat, ejusq;
regnum alteri ea meliori tradas. Hac
tua, rex, audita sententia, & per totum
imperium tuum quàm late patet publi-
cata, nulla mulier erit, quae non in precio
suum habeat conjugem: sive is magnus
sit, sive parvus. Placuit & regi & pro-
ceribus ea sententia: Mamuchanisq;
consilium secutus rex literas dimisit in
omnes suas provincias, &c. Esther 1.
Pactionem feci cum meis oculis ne-
quaquam aspicere virgines. Nam quá[?]

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the initial letter of "Fata" is a decorated capital and may be F or I; marked [?]. The last word "quá" on the final line is unclear and marked [?]. The text has long s throughout, transcribed as plain s. The section number "LXXIX." is a bare number and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading. No catchword is printed: the last line is full.
